description: Source code for WebSocket stream handling in Chromium, including request management, handshake stream creation, and error handling.

classes.name: Delegate
classes.description: Handles URLRequest delegate callbacks for WebSocket handshake process.

classes.name: WebSocketStreamRequestImpl
classes.description: Implements WebSocket stream request logic, manages handshake, and error handling.

classes.name: SSLErrorCallbacks
classes.description: Handles SSL error callbacks during WebSocket handshake.

methods.name: OnReceivedRedirect
methods.description: Handles redirect events during URLRequest, ensuring only internal redirects are allowed for WebSocket.

methods.name: OnResponseStarted
methods.description: Handles response start, checks response code, and triggers upgrade or failure.

methods.name: OnAuthRequired
methods.description: Handles authentication challenges during WebSocket handshake.

methods.name: OnCertificateRequested
methods.description: Handles client certificate requests, cancels as WebSockets do not support UI prompts.

methods.name: OnSSLCertificateError
methods.description: Handles SSL certificate errors, delegates to connect_delegate.

methods.name: OnReadCompleted
methods.description: Not implemented; should not be called.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Begins the WebSocket handshake request with a timeout.

methods.name: PerformUpgrade
methods.description: Completes the handshake and upgrades the connection, or reports failure.

methods.name: ReportFailure
methods.description: Handles failure reporting with appropriate error messages.

methods.name: OnTimeout
methods.description: Handles handshake timeout by cancelling the request.
